concept.title: If the engine does not start
concept.shortdesc: If the engine does not start, first check to see how much fuel there is and whether the 12V battery is discharged.

keywords.indexterm: if the engine does not start

section.title: If the engine does not turn over or turns over slowly

li.p: Be sure the vehicle is in N (Neutral) or P (Park) and the emergency brake is applied.
Check the 12V battery connections to be sure they are clean and tight.
Turn the interior light on. If the light dims or goes out when you operate the starter, the battery is discharged.
Check the starter connections to be sure they are securely tightened.

note.p: Do not push or pull the vehicle to start it. This could cause damage to your vehicle. Refer to

section.title: If the engine turns over normally but does not start

li.p: Check the fuel level and add fuel if necessary.
With the vehicle in OFF position, check all connectors at the ignition coils and spark plugs. Reconnect any that may be disconnected or loose.
Check the fuel line in the engine compartment.
If the engine still does not start, contact a professional workshop or seek other qualified assistance. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: If the hybrid vehicle shuts off
section.p: When the high-voltage battery or 12V battery is discharged, or when the fuel tank is empty, the hybrid system may not operate while driving.

li.p: Pull over your vehicle off the road in a safe area and shift to P (Park).
Turn on the hazard warning flashers.
Turn off the vehicle and try to start the hybrid system again, while depressing the brake and pressing the ENGINE START/STOP button.
If the engine still does not start, contact a professional workshop or seek other qualified assistance. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
